symptom: `check --references` refuses a building block placed several times with `as <prefix>`: `duplicate widget name 'Atlas_Web_Content.Card' (used 4 times) — … (CE0495)`, while exec writes a_container2/b_container2… and mx check reports 0 errors; since a reference error blocks exec, the documented prefix form could not be run without --no-check
cause: validatePageContextTree counted names on the PARSED tree, where `use building block X` / `use fragment X` is a sentinel WidgetV3 whose Name is the block's name. exec expands the sentinel first (expandFragments) and only then registers widget names
insight: A check that walks the parsed tree must walk the tree exec BUILDS: any pre-pass exec runs before naming (here sentinel expansion; ALTER PAGE's insert path already expanded before its duplicate check) has to run in check too. Do not just skip the sentinel — that loses the real collision: the same block twice with NO prefix makes exec refuse `duplicate widget name 'text22'`, and check now reports it by those expanded names. With no project (or a script-defined fragment) the reference contributes no names. Measured on 11.14.0: four prefixed Atlas Cards — check passes, exec writes, mx check 0 errors; two unprefixed — check reports container2/text22, exec refuses. Tests `validate_page_context_bb_559_test.go`; control = the pre-fix run, which failed all four with the reported message
